blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — The Department of Social Welfare and Development Field Office IX (DSWD FO IX) assisted 800 Filipino deportees who arrived from Sabah, Malaysia, at the Zamboanga City Port on Friday evening, Oct. 30.
